description.en: Taste-calibration workbench for fiction writing: while reading a batch of draft variants the author marks passages thumbs up/down, and one auxiliary model call distills those marks into reusable writing rules. Raw quotes stay in a separate evidence file, so only the rules ever enter a model context.
description.zh: 面向小说创作的品味校准工作台：读候选批稿时只点好/坏，再由一次辅助模型调用把标注提炼成可复用的写作规律。原文留在单独的证据文件里，进模型上下文的只有规律。
